title: Reflections triggered crowd motion alert
summary: A moving reflection on the concourse glass wall produced a low-confidence motion cluster [SIG-1009]. The event was dismissed after review because no human tracks crossed the detector line.
sop: Check the glass-wall camera view for repeated reflection artifacts.
Leave dismissed unless a second sensor confirms human movement.

vlm.description: The concourse appears calm and the bright motion is consistent with a reflection on glass.

second_opinion.question: Is there a benign explanation for the motion cluster?
second_opinion.answer: Yes, the motion aligns with a reflected light patch rather than a person track.

signals.detail: single low-confidence optical-flow cluster near glass wall

audit.action: priority downgraded after benign scene explanation
dismissed incident: Reflection only; no person track.
